summary: 50-year-old woman became disoriented and lost hiking Walker Ranch Open Space; her 911 call dropped on low battery; overnight search of Walker Ranch Loop and South Boulder Creek drainage; she walked into Eldorado Canyon State Park visitor center ~10 a.m. Sept 25, uninjured, reunited with husband (case #23-5276)
location: Walker Ranch Open Space / South Boulder Creek
notes: INSERT run974: BCSO news release Sep-27-2023, case #23-5276. Lost overnight; search teams: RMRG, Front Range Rescue Dogs, Mounted SAR, Boulder Emergency Squad.
